mechanistic.name: Mechanistic Bureaucracy (Taylor / Weber)
mechanistic.characteristics: High formalization, specialized roles, high centralization, tall hierarchy, rigid SLAs.
mechanistic.pros: Flawless operational consistency, minimal picking errors, strict inventory control.
mechanistic.cons: Slow innovation, rider alienation, inability to respond rapidly to local neighborhood shifts.

organic.name: Organic Agile Network (Burns & Stalker / Contingency)
organic.characteristics: Low formalization, decentralized decision rights, broad span of control, flat hierarchy.
organic.pros: Rapid hyper-local experimentation (Zepto Cafe, fresh flower delivery), agile rider redeployment.
organic.cons: Higher coordination overhead, potential shrinkage/pilferage, inconsistent customer service.

blinkit.rationale: Zomato corporate integration; highly centralized algorithmic supply chain and standardized dark-store picking SLAs.
blinkit.source: Zomato Ltd Note 34 Segment Disclosures & LinkedIn Headcount Audits

zepto.rationale: Decentralized entrepreneurial challenger structure; empowered city heads driving Zepto Cafe hyper-local rollouts.
zepto.source: Zepto Series G MCA Filings & City Head Interviews

swiggy_instamart.rationale: Cross-functional matrix structure sharing logistical infrastructure, delivery fleets, and tech pods with Swiggy Food.
swiggy_instamart.source: Swiggy Ltd SEBI DRHP Filing & Operating Benchmarks

bigbasket_now.rationale: Tata Digital enterprise scalar chain; formalized procurement processes, cold-chain compliance, and strict hierarchical approval gates.
bigbasket_now.source: Tata Consumer Products & Supermarket Grocery Supplies Annual Reports
